item.title: Meta faces landmark trial over child social media addiction
item.description: Four states sue Meta, alleging Facebook and Instagram were designed to addict children and that the company concealed mental health risks.

item.title: DHS defends tracking and warning agency critics
item.description: Federal officials confirmed ICE agents followed a New York man to his home, airport, and hotel to question him about critical comments.

item.title: USS Washington to replace USS Lincoln; Kushner to meet Netanyahu
item.description: The USS Washington heads to the Middle East to replace the USS Lincoln amid concerns over ship conditions. Jared Kushner is expected to meet with Netanyahu.
